untaught.why: "and practise" missing
untaught.k: I know that being able to speak better soon is something that can take time and practise
untaught.t: Sé que poder hablar mejor pronto es algo que puede tomar tiempo

untaught.why: "saben" (present) for "knew" (past)
untaught.k: I was sure they knew
untaught.t: estaba seguro de que saben

untaught.why: "estarán" (future) instead of "estarían" (conditional) for "they'd be"
untaught.k: I was sure they'd be ready soon
untaught.t: estaba seguro de que estarán listos pronto

untaught.why: "he aprendido" (present perfect) for "had learned" (pluperfect)
untaught.k: I was going to tell you what I had learned before the weekend
untaught.t: Iba a decirte lo que he aprendido antes del fin de semana

untaught.why: missing "also" (también)
untaught.k: He said he also wants them to give him back his money
untaught.t: Dijo que él quiere que le devuelvan su dinero

untaught.why: missing "only" (lo único)
untaught.k: The only thing I need right now is for them to give me back my money
untaught.t: Lo que necesito ahora mismo es que me devuelvan mi dinero

untaught.why: "hay que intentar" (impersonal) for "let us try" (we, inclusive)
untaught.k: I am not sure you will be ready in time but let us try
untaught.t: No estoy seguro de que estarás listo a tiempo pero hay que intentar

untaught.why: missing "also" (también)
untaught.k: I want to know when you will be ready to start so I can also get ready
untaught.t: Quiero saber cuándo estarás listo para empezar para estar listo

untaught.why: "estarás" (future) for "would be ready" (conditional)
untaught.k: He told me he was trying to find out when you would be ready to start
untaught.t: Me dijo que estaba intentando descubrir cuándo estarás listo para empezar

untaught.why: "has tenido" (present perfect) for "did you have" (simple past)
untaught.k: When did you have news from your friend?
untaught.t: ¿Cuándo has tenido noticias de tu amigo?

untaught.why: missing "sit down" (sentarme)
untaught.k: I like my coffee when I have time to sit down and relax
untaught.t: Me gusta mi café cuando tengo tiempo para relajarme un rato

untaught.why: "y ella lo hace" (and she does it) substituted for "and she knows that"
untaught.k: It is more important to speak often than to be perfect and she knows that
untaught.t: Es más importante hablar a menudo que ser perfecto y ella lo hace

untaught.why: "intentar ayudar" attaches to "les gusta" (people like to try to help) not "she tries to help them"
untaught.k: She knows people who like to learn and tries to help them
untaught.t: Ella conoce personas a las que les gusta aprender y intentar ayudar

untaught.why: ES "lo vio" (simple past) for EN "she'd seen it" (past perfect)
untaught.k: she told me she'd seen it
untaught.t: me dijo que lo vio

untaught.why: drops "too" (también) — no comparison marker for "practise too"
untaught.k: You speak with me all day — I'd like to practise too
untaught.t: Hablas conmigo todo el día, me gustaría practicar

untaught.why: "estoy empezando a sentirme cansado" (starting to feel tired) replaces "still tired"
untaught.k: I slept well this evening but I'm still tired
untaught.t: Dormí bien esta noche pero estoy empezando a sentirme cansado

untaught.why: adds "intentando" (trying to say) — English is plain "am saying"
untaught.k: I need to know if you understand what I am saying
untaught.t: Necesito saber si entiendes lo que estoy intentando decir

untaught.why: adds "intentando" (trying to say) — English is plain "were saying"
untaught.k: You were saying that we need to speak as soon as possible
untaught.t: Estabas intentando decir que necesitamos hablar lo antes posible

untaught.why: "we needed to know" (past) rendered as present "necesitamos saber"
untaught.k: They did not want to say anything about the arrangements even though we needed to know
untaught.t: No querían decir nada sobre los preparativos aunque necesitamos saber

untaught.why: "what you said to them" becomes "lo que dijiste sobre eso" (about that) — loses the recipient "to them"
untaught.k: They wanted to talk about what you said to them
untaught.t: Querían hablar de lo que dijiste sobre eso

untaught.why: "feeling ready" mistranslated as "sentirse bien" (feeling well), specific meaning lost
untaught.k: They didn't want to start before feeling ready
untaught.t: No querían empezar antes de sentirse bien

untaught.why: "had not seen" (past perfect) rendered as simple past "no vi"
untaught.k: I saw a friend at the weekend that I had not seen for a long time
untaught.t: Vi a un amigo el fin de semana al que no vi en mucho tiempo

untaught.why: "when we started learning" (past) rendered as "cuando aprendemos" (present)
untaught.k: I was hoping something interesting would happen today when we started learning
untaught.t: Esperaba que pasara algo interesante hoy cuando aprendemos

untaught.why: "always" weakened to "a menudo" (often)
untaught.k: I always think about doing things differently because I want to learn better
untaught.t: A menudo pienso en hacer de manera diferente porque quiero aprender mejor

rest.why: "allí" (there) added, not in English
rest.k: I didn't meet anyone I knew
rest.t: no vi a nadie que conociera allí

rest.why: "debería hacerlo" reads as a personal subject, losing the impersonal "it should be done"
rest.k: I told her it should be done before Thursday
rest.t: le dije que debería hacerlo antes del jueves

rest.why: "debería" (should) added, turns a direct instruction into a suggestion
rest.k: I told her to lead the way
rest.t: le dije que debería liderar el camino

rest.why: "quería hablar de" (wanted to talk about) replaces "had...an idea to discuss"
rest.k: She works with your sister and said she had a very interesting idea to discuss
rest.t: Trabaja con tu hermana y dijo que quería hablar de una idea muy interesante

rest.why: "antes de irse" defaults to "I" leaving, not "before HE left"
rest.k: I wanted to give it to my father before he left
rest.t: Quería dárselo a mi padre antes de irse

rest.why: "recordar" (remember) substituted for "appreciate"
rest.k: I think it's important to appreciate how much you've already done
rest.t: Pienso que es importante recordar lo mucho que ya has hecho

rest.why: imperative "Just give me" rendered as question "Puedes darme"
rest.k: Just give me a little time to think before I answer and I will do much better
rest.t: Puedes darme un poco de tiempo para pensar antes de que conteste y lo puedo hacer mucho mejor

rest.why: "dijo que quiere saber" adds a reporting layer not in "asked if"
rest.k: She asked if you could come back in a few days because we need more time
rest.t: Ella dijo que quiere saber si puedes volver en unos días porque necesitamos más tiempo

rest.why: "quería" (past) for "wants" (present); "asked if we could" softened to a statement
rest.k: She asked if we could talk after the meeting because she wants to tell me something important
rest.t: Ella dijo que quería hablar después de la reunión porque quería decirme algo importante

rest.why: "si llevas" (you take) for impersonal "it takes too long"
rest.k: Does it matter to you that it takes too long to answer?
rest.t: ¿Te importa si llevas demasiado tiempo para contestar?

rest.why: ES "ha estado" (present perfect) for EN "was" (simple past)
rest.k: since the second day it was hard
rest.t: desde el segundo día ha estado difícil

rest.why: adds "música" (music) not mentioned in EN "I wish they wouldn't play"
rest.k: I wish they wouldn't play
rest.t: ojalá no pusieran música

rest.why: "had wanted" (past perfect) rendered as imperfect "quería", not pluperfect
rest.k: She had wanted to put the letter in her bag last week
rest.t: Ella quería poner la carta en su bolso la semana pasada

rest.why: adds "casi" (nearly) and "como si estuviera" (as if) not asked for by English
rest.k: It surprises me how quickly I am starting to feel ready to go
rest.t: Me sorprende lo rápido que estoy empezando a sentir como si estuviera casi listo para irme

rest.why: "if I could" (conditional) rendered as present indicative "si puedo" (if I can)
rest.k: It would be great if I could speak Spanish as fast as possible
rest.t: Sería genial si puedo hablar español lo más rápido posible

rest.why: "trying to improve" mistranslated as "intentando aprender" (trying to learn)
rest.k: I'm not speaking quickly enough but I'm trying to improve
rest.t: No estoy hablando lo suficientemente rápido pero estoy intentando aprender

rest.why: English "she was not worried" (3rd person) rendered as "no deberías preocuparte" (you shouldn't worry, 2nd person)
rest.k: She told me she was not worried about doing that
rest.t: Ella me dijo que no debería preocuparte por hacer eso

rest.why: English "he asked me to try" rendered as "él quiere intentar" (he wants to try) — wrong subject/actor doing the trying
rest.k: He asked me to try something similar with his dog
rest.t: Él quiere intentar algo parecido con su perro

rest.why: "before we talk about the rest" reduced to generic "antes de seguir" (before continuing)
rest.k: There's something else I want to tell you before we talk about the rest
rest.t: Hay otra cosa de la que quiero hablar contigo antes de seguir

rest.why: "I've been thinking about it" rendered as present "Pienso mucho en eso"
rest.k: I've been thinking about it and I'd like you to tell me what you need
rest.t: Pienso mucho en eso y me gustaría que me dijeras lo que necesitas

rest.why: "if you could explain" (conditional) rendered as present indicative "si puedes"
rest.k: It would be helpful if you could explain that again
rest.t: Sería útil si puedes explicar eso otra vez

rest.why: "may have gone home" (uncertain) rendered as definite simple past "ya fue a casa"
rest.k: I have not seen her anywhere in the office since this morning and I'm afraid she may have gone home already
rest.t: No la he visto en algún sitio en la oficina desde esta mañana y me temo que ya fue a casa

rest.why: "may have gone home" (uncertain) rendered as definite simple past "ya fue a casa"
rest.k: I have not seen my friend at work today and I'm afraid she may have gone home already
rest.t: No he visto a mi amiga en el trabajo hoy y me temo que ya fue a casa

rest.why: "I thought at the time" (past) rendered as present "pienso"
rest.k: She said it was a good idea but I thought at the time that it was not so sure
rest.t: Ella dijo que era una buena idea pero pienso que no estoy tan seguro de eso

rest.why: "the week after next" rendered as "la semana que viene" (next week), loses the "after next" offset
rest.k: We need to finish the arrangements before the week after next
rest.t: Necesitamos terminar los preparativos antes de la semana que viene

rest.why: "if I could have done it well" (past hypothetical) rendered as present subjunctive "si pudiera hacerlo bien"
rest.k: I would have done it differently if I could have done it well this time
rest.t: Lo habría hecho de manera diferente si pudiera hacerlo bien esta vez

rest.why: drops "even" (aun/incluso) before "when something feels very difficult"
rest.k: She was saying that it is important to work hard even when something feels very difficult
rest.t: Ella estaba diciendo que es importante trabajar duro cuando algo es muy difícil

rest.why: "deeper way" mistranslated as "de manera más interesante" (more interesting way)
rest.k: She was saying you get to know someone in a deeper way when you work hard together
rest.t: Ella estaba diciendo que llegas a conocer a alguien de manera más interesante trabajando juntos

rest.why: "before the end of the day" (no subject) rendered as "antes de que termines" (before you finish) — introduces "you"
rest.k: I was hoping something different would happen before the end of the day
rest.t: Esperaba que pasara algo diferente antes de que termines

rest.why: "after you finished" (past) rendered as "termines" (future/present subjunctive)
rest.k: It was something I was hoping would happen after you finished
rest.t: Era algo que esperaba que pasara después de que termines
